title: "Contributing in a win is bigger than century" | Dean Elgar post match press conference | SA vs IND
quote_text:
Q: How does it feel on winning the match as captain?

Dean Elgar: "I don't know it hasn't really sunk in yet but first and foremost it's a test win for South Africa I mean we've fought long and hard for this this kind of victory and yeah the last four days has really pushed us to different levels and different areas within our team and the guys have responded brilliantly with regards to certain requests that I’ve obviously asked us to do and you know sitting here it's nice too it's great it's actually great to know that we've accomplished another test when"
